from pathlib import Path
import json,re

state=Path.home()/'.local/state/prediction-project-executor/DEV-PRED-ASTRA-AUTONOMOUS-MODEL-DETAILS-20261005.json'
if not state.is_file():
    print('DETAILS_STATE=MISSING',flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(31)
obj=json.loads(state.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
if obj.get('status')!='PASS' or obj.get('exit_code') not in (0,'0'):
    print('DETAILS_NOT_PASS',flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(32)
blob='\n'.join(str(x) for x in (obj.get('operations') or []))
m=re.search(r'ASTRA_EXACT_SLUG=([^\s]+)',blob)
if not m:
    print('ASTRA_EXACT_SLUG=NOT_FOUND',flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(33)
slug=m.group(1).strip()
print('ASTRA_EXACT_SLUG='+slug,flush=True)
print('AUTONOMOUS_MODEL_PROVENANCE_READY=true',flush=True)
